source_binding.quote: Data Connection now supports authenticating Snowflake connections using an external identity provider (such as Entra ID, Okta, or PingFederate) via the OAuth2 client credentials flow. Users can configure a token endpoint, client ID, client secret, OAuth scopes, and user claim to establish the connection. This authentication method provides an alternative for organizations that manage identity through external providers rather than direct Snowflake credentials.
